description: Find Align's sourced guides on cross-border business payments: SWIFT, SEPA, ACH, Fedwire and UK rails, business accounts for non-resident companies, stablecoins (USDT, USDC, EURC), and rules such as MiCA, the GENIUS Act, the Travel Rule and DAC8.
